summary: The MaintDestination component appears to handle the management of destination records within the HSPnet application. It includes functionality for adding, editing, and reactivating destinations, as well as various validations for input fields.
purpose: To manage destination records, providing capabilities to add, edit, view, and deactivate/reactivate destinations within HSPnet.

workflows.name: Destination Management
steps: Fill agency and site dropdowns based on session or query parameters.
Validate inputs such as phone and email.
Use event handlers for dropdown changes to refresh data.
On form submission, validate page; then save or update destination records.
Provide client script validation for fields like phone and fax.

business_rules: If user is System Administrator and is in their own agency, the screen is editable.
Local Administrators can edit based on service access.
Users cannot edit destinations in their own agency unless they are a System Administrator or a Receiving User.
validations: First and last names must not be empty when adding a new contact.
conditions: Form fields are validated only if the relevant selection in dropdowns suggests it's required.
If the contact dropdown is set to a specific value, additional fields become visible and required.
system_behavior: Page load and refresh scripts manage dropdowns and validation.
Data refreshes upon dropdown changes or form submissions.
Error and warning panels handle user feedback.
exceptions: If no service or site is selected, the dropdowns attempt to select defaults based on user session.
Hiding fields if user doesn't have edit permissions.
